mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 PM, here is today's balanced dish: the weather is a warm 82 degrees with clear skies, providing a lovely view near the Verona Area High School, and the moon is currently in a waning crescent phase.

The City is reviewing new development projects at 201 South Main Street and the Liberty Business Park, while the City Clerks Office has successfully wrapped up the I Voted sticker design contest for students.
You can catch Yoga at Insight Wellness today, followed by a busy Tuesday featuring trivia at Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Macs, plus the Downtown Farmers Market coming up on Wednesday.
Reflecting on the weekly police report, officers responded on August 5 to a residence on Whalen Road to arrest a suspect on a probation violation warrant after a brief pursuit.
Indulge in the Georgia Peach flavor of the day at Culvers, which remains open until 10 PM tonight.
